<thought>Based on the observed protonated ion at m/z 183.045 (≈ [M+H]⁺) the neutral monoisotopic mass is about 182.038 Da. The formula C₉H₁₀O₄ matches this mass most closely (exact neutral mass 182.0579 Da, giving an [M+H]⁺ of 183.0652 Da, within typical high‑resolution error). Therefore the most plausible molecular formula is C9H10O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10O4</final_answer>
